articles.title: Hungary’s OTP eyes acquisition in Ukraine, with Sense Bank and Ukrgasbank seen as likely targets

CEE’s leading lender also sees opportunities to expand in markets where it already operates, including Albania, Croatia, Serbia and Uzbekistan, financial website Portfolio.
